items.prompt: Why must the M2 update use both the old mean and the newly updated mean?

options.text: The two means are always numerically identical
options.why: They generally change when the new value differs from the old mean.

options.text: It makes every floating input exact without limits
options.why: The recurrence still has finite-precision and range limits.

options.text: That is the stated centered-squares recurrence
options.why: Replacing the new mean with the old one changes the quantity accumulated.

options.text: It avoids needing to count how many values were read
options.why: The mean and variance denominators still require the count.

items.explanation: The increment is (x-old_mean)*(x-new_mean). Trace the small example to see why using the old mean twice overcounts it.
